svg.title: Standard: start on the side wall below its FLOWER, go up the corridor, wait, shoot 4, park - RED alliance
svg.desc: Top view of the 141.35 by 141.35 inch BIOBUZZ field, audience at the bottom, red alliance on the left. Route partner_standard_red_wall_a2 for the RED alliance, starting in tile A2, with 10 steps: 1 START at (8.8, 28.0, 90 deg); 2 DRIVE away from the wall constant to 26.0, 36.0; 3 DRIVE up the corridor constant to 26.0, 123.0; 4 DRIVE past the FLOWER constant to 57.9, 123.0; 5 DRIVE to the shooting pose constant to 57.9, 125.4; 6 WAIT_FOR_TIP until the camera sees the HIVE tipped, giving up at 19.6 s on the route clock; 7 SHOOT 4 at UP cell from (57.9, 125.4, 90 deg); 8 DRIVE off the wall constant to 57.9, 112.0; 9 DRIVE to zone linear to 12.0, 108.0; 10 PARK at (12.0, 108.0, 0 deg). First tip: partner tips first, assumed at 12.0 s; latest that works 19.1 s. Estimated 20.9 s, POLLEN balance -4, up to 8 points for our robot; 0 errors and 0 warnings.
svg.text: Standard: start on the side wall below its FLOWER, go up the corridor, wait, shoot 4, park - RED alliance
id partner_standard_red_wall_a2 | start tile A2 | 10 steps | red ink | first tip: partner tips first, assumed at 12.0 s; latest that works 19.1 s

g.title: Where a robot facing 90 degrees may be set up (rule G304): the tinted stretches of the own walls. The gaps are the FLOWERS, the LOADING ZONE, the corners and the center line.
g.text: tinted: where this start may stand (G304)

g.title: step 2: DRIVE away from the wall constant to 26.0, 36.0 (t = 0.0 to 1.2 s) - Sideways first, so the robot is well clear of the red-wall FLOWER (its plate is 5 in deep and at y 44 to 50) when it goes up.
step 3: DRIVE up the corridor constant to 26.0, 123.0 (t = 1.2 to 3.9 s) - Front first up the corridor past the red-wall FLOWER and the HIVE, keeping the heading.
step 4: DRIVE past the FLOWER constant to 57.9, 123.0 (t = 3.9 to 5.4 s)
step 5: DRIVE to the shooting pose constant to 57.9, 125.4 (t = 5.4 to 6.1 s)
step 8: DRIVE off the wall constant to 57.9, 112.0 (t = 18.0 to 19.1 s) - Straight away from the rear wall toward the open floor, keeping the heading, so the robot does not turn next to the FLOWER.
step 9: DRIVE to zone linear to 12.0, 108.0 (t = 19.1 to 20.9 s) - Across the open floor above the HIVE keep-out while turning to face the zone, into the own LOADING ZONE.
step 1: START at (8.8, 28.0, 90 deg) (t = 0.0 to 0.0 s) - Left side ON the red wall, facing the rear wall, in tile A2, below the red-wall FLOWER.

step 7: SHOOT 4 at UP cell from (57.9, 125.4, 90 deg) (t = 12.5 to 18.0 s) - 4 POLLEN into the empty cell do not tip it (it needs 8): they are banked for the second tip in TELEOP, so there is no spill here (G409).
step 10: PARK at (12.0, 108.0, 0 deg) (t = 20.9 to 20.9 s) - Overlaps the LOADING ZONE by 7.0 in (the zone is 11 in deep), standing 4.0 in off the wall so the LEAVE is kept too (QA21).
step 1: START at (8.8, 28.0, 90 deg) (t = 0.0 to 0.0 s) - Left side ON the red wall, facing the rear wall, in tile A2, below the red-wall FLOWER.

step 2: DRIVE away from the wall constant to 26.0, 36.0 (t = 0.0 to 1.2 s) - Sideways first, so the robot is well clear of the red-wall FLOWER (its plate is 5 in deep and at y 44 to 50) when it goes up.
step 3: DRIVE up the corridor constant to 26.0, 123.0 (t = 1.2 to 3.9 s) - Front first up the corridor past the red-wall FLOWER and the HIVE, keeping the heading.
step 4: DRIVE past the FLOWER constant to 57.9, 123.0 (t = 3.9 to 5.4 s)
step 5: DRIVE to the shooting pose constant to 57.9, 125.4 (t = 5.4 to 6.1 s)

step 6: WAIT_FOR_TIP until the camera sees the HIVE tipped, giving up at 19.6 s on the route clock (t = 6.1 to 12.5 s) - Waits for the CAMERA to see the rear cell up and steady (0.5 s), never for a time. 19.6 s on the route clock is the give-up time, the latest the rest of the route allows rounded down to a tenth: a partner that tips later gets no volley from us, the robot skips it and goes on to LEAVE and PARK.

step 7: SHOOT 4 at UP cell from (57.9, 125.4, 90 deg) (t = 12.5 to 18.0 s) - 4 POLLEN into the empty cell do not tip it (it needs 8): they are banked for the second tip in TELEOP, so there is no spill here (G409).
step 8: DRIVE off the wall constant to 57.9, 112.0 (t = 18.0 to 19.1 s) - Straight away from the rear wall toward the open floor, keeping the heading, so the robot does not turn next to the FLOWER.
step 9: DRIVE to zone linear to 12.0, 108.0 (t = 19.1 to 20.9 s) - Across the open floor above the HIVE keep-out while turning to face the zone, into the own LOADING ZONE.
step 10: PARK at (12.0, 108.0, 0 deg) (t = 20.9 to 20.9 s) - Overlaps the LOADING ZONE by 7.0 in (the zone is 11 in deep), standing 4.0 in off the wall so the LEAVE is kept too (QA21).

g.text: WAIT FOR TIP (give up at 19.6 s)
Estimated time 20.9 s of the 30.0 s AUTO (placeholder timing) | Our AUTO points: 8 (LEAVE 3, PARK 5, HIVE TIP 0)
POLLEN: hold 4 at start, +0 taken, -4 fired, 0 at the end (balance -4) | Validator: no findings | Partner tip +20 (not ours)
